identity.title: TEMPLATES: Characterization of a Merger in the Dusty Lensing SPT0418─47 System

paper_type_evidence.quote: JWST NIRCam and MIRI imaging observations presented in this paper were acquired as part of the Early Release Science program Targeting Extremely Magnified Panchromatic Lensed Arcs and Their Extended Star Formation (TEMPLATES).
the ALMA detection of \[C II\] emission confirms that SPT0418B lies at the same redshift as SPT0418A

redshift_or_distance.value: z = 4.225 (lensed by a foreground elliptical at z = 0.263)

evidence.quote: a strongly-lensed, dusty star-forming galaxy at redshift $z=4.225$ and an associated multiply-imaged companion

question.value: Is the lensed dusty galaxy SPT0418-47 isolated or interacting with a companion, and how do the stellar masses and star formation of the two galaxies compare to the main sequence?

evidence.quote: We combine JWST imaging and ALMA \[C II\] data and investigate the environment of this system to discern whether this system is isolated or is dynamically interacting.

findings_qualitative.value: Extended structure near SPT0418A is suggestive of a tidal feature

evidence.quote: extended structure associated with SPT0418A in the lensing reconstruction that is suggestive of a tidal feature

findings_qualitative.value: Both galaxies are consistent with the main sequence, so the merger has not elevated star formation

evidence.quote: this ongoing interaction has not noticeably elevated the star formation levels

claims.hypothesis: SPT0418B is physically associated with SPT0418A and the system is a merger
claims.experiment: ALMA [CII] at the companion positions plus a lens model source reconstruction
claims.result: [CII] at about -56 km/s; 4.42 kpc projected separation
claims.finding: SPT0418B lies at the same redshift, forming an ongoing minor merger

evidence.quote: The simplest interpretation of these results is that we are witnessing an ongoing minor merger in this system.

claims.hypothesis: The stellar mass ratio indicates a minor merger
claims.experiment: cigale and prospector SED fits with magnification correction

evidence.quote: consistent with being a $\sim 4$ to 1 ongoing minor merger between the two galaxies

claims.experiment: Compare sSFR to the main sequence
claims.result: sSFR consistent with the main sequence

evidence.quote: there is no evidence that the merger event is actively elevating the star formation in either galaxy

why_this_method.value: A 50 mas taper balances resolution and sensitivity and matches NIRCam resolution

evidence.quote: offers a reasonable compromise between spatial resolution and sensitivity and is well-matched to the resolution of the NIRCam imaging

limitations_admitted.value: Lens light subtraction was done separately from lens modeling, which hindered modeling with background noise

evidence.quote: it would be prudent to perform the lens light subtraction within the software used to conduct the lens modeling

limitations_admitted.value: Constraints on SPT0418B are less robust owing to limited photometric detections

evidence.quote: The constraints on SPT0418B are less robust due to the more limited set of photometric detections

referee_caveats_inferred: Stellar masses differ by 2-4x between codes owing to the SFH assumptions
Only one FIR point constrains SPT0418B
Merger inference rests on a projected separation and a velocity offset of about -56 km/s only
Lens model uncertainties are likely underestimated, with lens light subtracted separately
